# Tasks

TDD order per `openspec/config.yaml`: pure-logic unit tests before wiring.
No task here may introduce a reasoning model — the compile plan is a
deterministic transduction of oracle-held ground truth.

## 1. Compile plan (corpus side — changes generated bytes)
- [x] 1.1 `ConclusionRecord` schema + strict validation; exported JSON schema committed like the others
- [x] 1.2 Oracle derivation: `cites` from the sources asserting the claim, `supersedes` from the supersession chain, `disputes` from contested claims — unit-tested against a hand-built claim set before any generation wiring
- [x] 1.3 Emit `compile-plan.jsonl` from `generate_corpus`; hash into the release manifest
- [x] 1.4 Determinism: double-generation byte equality, seeded
- [x] 1.5 Generation-time refusal when the plan contains no disputed pair (the dimension must not ship structurally unpassable again — 4b.33)
- [x] 1.6 **Neutrality guard:** a test asserting the record carries no field named after or shaped by any single product's API

## 2. Native rendering (fairness — write basic-memory FIRST)
- [x] 2.1 **`basic-memory-local` renderer first**, deliberately: letting the second product constrain the record's fields is what stops the neutral record quietly becoming exomem's `remember` signature. Per-conclusion parity report
- [x] 2.2 `exomem-local` renderer: `remember(title, body, sources=[…])`, `replace_memory` for supersession; parity report
- [x] 2.3 `graybox-local` declares the tier unsupported (its compile path is an LLM organize pass); assert it is excluded and never zeroed
- [x] 2.4 `oracle-retrieval` compiles the plan exactly — the chain-preservation ceiling
- [x] 2.5 `null-abstain` ingests, compiles nothing, retrieves nothing — the floor
- [ ] 2.6 Parity completeness test: every conclusion accounted for by every declaring adapter

## 3. Harness wiring
- [x] 3.1 `--altitude {raw_source,compiled}`; adapters declare what they can honour; run refuses a tier it cannot apply evenly (4b.29 rule, applied to altitude)
- [x] 3.2 Compile phase runs after ingest, before queries; failures are recorded and kept in denominators
- [x] 3.3 Reporting: withhold altitude-dependent dimensions across mixed altitudes, naming both
